_comment_layer_injection: Enable automatic layer injection during terrain generation. Uses heightmap analysis for layer distribution. Requires restart to take effect.
_comment_rtf_layer_injection: Enable layer injection using ReTerraForged terrain data. Requires ReTerraForged mod.
_comment_vanilla_noise_router_layer_inje: Use vanilla's NoiseRouter density functions (continents, erosion, ridges) to derive a smooth synthetic cell height for layer placement. Replaces the slope-based heuristic with the same fractional formula used by RTF injection. Has no effect when RTF is active. Requires layer_injection=true. Default: false
_comment_injection_mode: When to inject layers: CARVERS (before structures, may need cleanup) or POST_FEATURES (after structures, cleaner result). Requires restart.
_comment_skip_snowy_biomes: Skip layer generation in snowy/cold biomes to avoid interfering with natural snow. Default: true
_comment_improve_snowy_biomes: Use vanilla snow layers in snowy biomes with original un-reduced layer value. Plant conversion, rocks, foliage still apply. Requires skip_snowy_biomes=false. Default: false
_comment_break_snow_layers_to_mapped_lay: When breaking a snow layer, replace it with the mapped layer block (from block_mappings) based on the block below, with layer value reduced by 1. Default: false
_comment_underwater_layers: Enable layer placement on underwater surfaces (ocean/river floors). Layer blocks must support waterlogging. Default: false
_comment_replace_dirt_path: When placing layers on dirt_path, also replace the dirt_path block with the full-block equivalent of the layer (e.g. conquest:sandy_soil). Default: false
_comment_place_wet_sand: When placing a sand layer (conquest:sand_layer), use conquest:wet_sand_layer instead if the layer will be waterlogged or is below Y=63 (sea level). Default: false
_comment_plant_injection: Enable plant injection: layer blocks become transparent to plant placement, and vanilla plants above layers are converted to Conquest variants. Requires restart.
_comment_tree_injection: Enable tree injection: layer blocks become transparent to tree feature generation, allowing trees to grow on layered terrain. Requires restart.
_comment_replace_sea_grass: Convert vanilla seagrass/tall_seagrass to Conquest equivalents. Conquest seagrass lacks the layer property, so they are placed without a layer value. Requires plant_injection. Default: false
_comment_cr_nbt_trees: Place hand-crafted CR trees from NBT files during world generation. Tree species and biomes are configured in cr_nbt_trees.json. NBT files live in nbt_trees/<species>/. Requires Conquest Reforged. Default: false
_comment_cr_nbt_trees_vanilla_fallback: When cr_nbt_trees=true and no NBT species is found for a growing sapling (not configured or no files), allow vanilla tree generation to proceed. false = suppress vanilla, sapling will not grow. Default: true
_comment_place_rocks: Place rock blocks above layers on mapped surface blocks. Uses cr_rock_mappings.json for surface-to-rock mapping. Default: false
_comment_conquest_enhanced_rocks: Per-biome weighted rock placement using cr_enhanced_rock_mappings.json. Requires Conquest Reforged. Uses chance_to_place_rocks unless overridden per biome. Biomes not in the file fall back to cr_rock_mappings.json. Default: false
_comment_chance_to_place_rocks: Chance (0.0-1.0) to place a rock above an eligible layer. 0.1 = 10% chance. Recommended: 0.05-0.2
_comment_rock_density_mode: How rock density (1-4) is chosen: RANDOM (uniform) or DECREASED (biased toward smaller rocks, controlled by rock_density_factor)
_comment_rock_density_factor: Bias strength for DECREASED mode. Each density has 1/factor the chance of the previous. 1.0 = uniform, 4.0 = ~75/19/5/1% distribution. Recommended: 3.0-5.0
_comment_place_extra_foliage: Place conquest foliage above layers on mapped surface blocks where the position is empty. Uses cr_extra_foliage_mappings.json. Default: false
_comment_conquest_enhanced_extra_foliage: Per-biome weighted grass placement using cr_enhanced_extra_foliage.json. Requires Conquest Reforged. Uses chance_to_place_extra_foliage. Default: false
_comment_chance_to_place_extra_foliage: Chance (0.0-1.0) to place extra foliage above an eligible layer. 0.1 = 10% chance. Recommended: 0.05-0.3
_comment_structure_injection: Enable structure-aware layer injection: layers are not placed inside structure piece bounding boxes (buildings, roads, etc.). Required by all structure sub-features below. Default: false
_comment_cross_chunk_structure_detection: Also check structure references in neighboring chunks to catch structures that start outside the current chunk. May cause server tick timeouts during heavy pre-generation (e.g. Chunky). Disable when pre-generating. Requires structure_injection. Default: false
_comment_structure_footprint_check: Suppress layers within the overall XZ footprint of each StructureStart (the hull of all its pieces). Catches cleared ground, plazas and paths between buildings that fall between individual piece bounding boxes. Trees are not affected (they have no StructureStart). Requires structure_injection. Default: false
_comment_structure_footprint_below_margi: How many blocks below the structure start's minimum Y to still suppress layers. Handles terrain carved into by the structure (paths dug into a hillside, excavated basements). Default: 8
_comment_structure_footprint_above_margi: How many blocks above the structure start's maximum Y to still suppress layers. RTF terrain within a footprint can sit a few blocks above the highest roof piece; without this margin those surface columns escape detection. Keep small to avoid suppressing layers legitimately above underground structures (e.g. mineshaft at Y=50, surface at Y=65 — with default 4 the gap is 15 so surface is not suppressed). Default: 4
_comment_conservative_surface_heightmap: At injection time, compare the current surface Y against RTF's noise-derived base Y. If it deviates beyond the up/down tolerances, skip the layer. Catches any structure that raises or lowers the terrain at a column, regardless of shape or type. RTF-only feature. Default: false
_comment_conservative_surface_tolerance_: Maximum upward deviation (blocks) between actual surface Y and RTF's expected base Y. 1 tolerates natural snow (+1 block) while still catching structures that raised terrain by 2+. Default: 1

Maximum downward deviation (blocks) between actual surface Y and RTF's expected base Y. 0 is strict (natural terrain sits exactly at RTF's base); increase only if natural terrain variation causes false positives. Default: 0
_comment_conservative_surface_fallback: When conservative_surface_heightmap detects a modified column (deviation beyond tolerance), place a layer with a fixed value instead of skipping entirely. Default: false
_comment_conservative_surface_fallback_v: Layer value (1-8) to place when the surface is above RTF's expected base (terrain raised by structure), set to 0 to skip. Default 0.
Layer value (1-8) to place when the surface is below RTF's expected base (terrain lowered by structure), set to 0 to skip. Default 4.
_comment_structure_injection_extra_bound: Expand each structure piece bounding box outward in XZ by structure_injection_extra_bounds_distance blocks, adding a buffer zone where layers are also suppressed. Requires structure_injection. Default: false
Radius (blocks) to expand structure bounding boxes outward in XZ when structure_injection_extra_bounds=true. Default: 4
_comment_enclosed_space_check: Skip layers if there is a solid block (ceiling) within enclosed_space_height blocks above the layer position. Catches enclosed interiors not covered by bounding boxes. Requires structure_injection. Default: false
_comment_enclosed_space_height: Maximum height (blocks) to scan above a layer position when looking for a ceiling. Recommended: 4-6.
_comment_structure_cleanup: Post-injection correction pass: remove layers where a solid ceiling is detected above or the surface block is a known structure material. Requires structure_injection. Default: false
_comment_structure_no_layers: Heightmap-based detection: captures the pre-feature heightmap and removes layers where structures raised the terrain by 2+ blocks. Default: false
_comment_second_pass_cleanup: After structure_injection or structure_no_layers removes/blocks a layer, taper the 8 in-chunk neighbors: cap values above 4 to 4, decrement others by 1, remove at 0. Default: false
_comment_structure_skip_elevated: Skip layer placement where a structure elevated terrain above the RTF noise-derived surface Y. Only effective with injection_mode=POST_FEATURES and RTF active. Default: false
_comment_structure_replace_elevated: When structure_skip_elevated=true and the elevation is exactly 1 block: replace the raised surface block with the correct layer instead of skipping. Default: false
_comment_structure_replace_elevated_high: When structure_replace_elevated=true: also apply replacement for elevations greater than 1 block (up to structure_replace_elevated_high_max). Default: false
Maximum elevation delta (blocks above natural surface) to apply high-elevation replacement. Positions elevated more than this are skipped. Default: 3
_comment_structure_skip_extra_cleanup: When structure_skip_elevated=true: after detecting an elevated position, also remove layer blocks within structure_skip_extra_cleanup_distance blocks of that position. Default: false
_comment_structure_skip_extra_cleanup_di: Chebyshev radius (blocks) around each elevated position to scan for layer blocks to remove. Default: 2
_comment_debug_logging: Master switch for debug logging. All per-category flags below require this to be true. Default: false
_comment_debug_log_categories: Per-category debug flags. Only take effect when debug_logging=true.
